methods: Read-only precheck of all 89 registered current and frozen bytes and registration/settings/manifest hash references before reading completed results.
Check exact unique 216 row keys and ordering; re-render strict summary in memory using the registered-hash-matching summary module and compare all fields.

Independently reparse structured RESULT and failure records from all 458 saved target/reference stdout files, bind plans/contracts/RTL/testbench/reference-sampling packets/execution files, recompute detections and first-detection cycles.

Ledger lacks row IDs; this mapping uses documented order plus body/usage crosschecks.

Read the final report and budget; identify and verify correction of row121 cycle-cap/actual-use mixup; bind corrected final report SHA.
known_limitations: This is a proxy machine-evidence review, not H02 or H01, a human trial, cross-machine reproduction or real new API/DUT execution by the reviewer.
Strict whole-comparison eligibility remains false because four registered tasks lack auditable actual simulation; failed and unknown tasks remain in the 24-defect denominator.
Three replies are recorded as duplicate_json_key and blocked, with hash/size but without original body. Raw duplicate-key content cannot be independently inspected or reconstructed.
No actual json_invalid occurred in this batch and no malformed .txt reply was retained here; synthetic code-test evidence must remain separate.

Five later schema-valid actions include one stop without additional simulation. Only four tasks actually executed after an ordinary format rejection, including three defects and one correct reference.
All 23 feedback detections occur in the first actual DUT episode. Two required prior format/input correction requests, so this is not 23 first-request detections or simulation-feedback causal gain.

The study repeats eight known development defects three times, has no independent holdout or paired model RNG, and changes prompt and recovery together. Counts do not establish statistical significance, pure retry causality or generalization.
Shared caps do not equate actual resource use; no-feedback hides input/schema diagnostics in addition to DUT/coverage feedback and retains result-driven early stopping.
The compact public copies include all API trajectories and retained replies but omit complete 458-side stdout and execution artifacts. They are not a full portable replay package.
Reported token usage is not a service-provider monetary bill. Historical usage is not deducted from the current batch; remaining budget is not a new batch authorization.
Existing code-review, regression, browser, replay, PDF and old evidence-package claims are not revalidated or relabeled by this results review.
